parole.significato: An ancient Indonesian motif, pattern, or design of batik and tenun with light brown or dark brown as its base color.
parole.testo: From Indonesian geringsing, from Javanese gringsing.

parole.significato: An Indonesian (Javanese) cracker, made from tapioca flour, salt, ground shrimps and various traditional spices.
parole.testo: Borrowed from Indonesian krupuk or kerupuk, derived from Javanese ꦏꦿꦸꦥꦸꦏ꧀ (krupuk), inherited from Old Javanese kerupuk. Cognate with Dutch kroepoek.
